objective: DTP401525-XE固定で連続16時間録音可能なUSBレコーダーの完成寸法を最小化し、5台試作の発注判断に必要な設計・製造資料を揃える。
battery: DTP401525-XE 3.7V 110mAh; Marutsu DTP401525(EZ3) is same pack
sales: Programmed assembled PCB and case; user purchases battery separately and assembles without soldering or wire modification.

constraints.interface: USB-C charging and MSC; macOS/Windows/Linux importer
constraints.size: Aim for Omi size; compare identified reference and complete assembly. Consult before relaxation.25x25x15 is historical engineering assumption, not a user dimension.

optimization_order: Meet battery electrical limits and continuous recording requirements
Minimize complete assembled footprint and thickness, reporting both and volume
Reduce parts and assembly complexity without removing required protection
Report five-unit total cost and remaining risks
deliverables: Routed PCB and matching manufacturing files
Case CAD and unmodified-battery assembly instructions
Verification plan distinguishing calculations from actual measurements
Complete exterior 3D model and internal/exploded assembly model including battery, original leads, connectors, insulation and retention
Same-scale Omi comparison models and front/side/overlay views, identifying reference product/version, dimension sources and uncertain geometry
current_stage: Prototype circuit selected with qualification work remaining; 24x27 mm PCB partially routed (20 unconnected items). Complete case dimensions and Omi fit are not established.
